## ObjectSpawnerFile

ObjectSpawnerFile is a mission object list loaded through `cfggameplay.json ->
WorldsData.objectSpawnersArr`.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 1 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### ObjectSpawnerFile.Objects

Key: `Objects`

Objects are the map objects to create with the configured class or model,
transform, and persistence behavior.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`ObjectSpawnerEntry`](#objectspawnerentry) (`#/$defs/ObjectSpawnerEntry`) |

## ObjectSpawnerEntry

ObjectSpawnerEntry defines one object placement created by the mission object
spawner.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 6 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### ObjectSpawnerEntry.customString

Key: `customString`

Path: [`Objects`](#objectspawnerfileobjects).`[]`.`customString`

CustomString passes custom data to the spawned class's OnSpawnByObjectSpawner
script callback.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

### ObjectSpawnerEntry.enableCEPersistency

Key: `enableCEPersistency`

Path: [`Objects`](#objectspawnerfileobjects).`[]`.`enableCEPersistency`

EnableCEPersistency spawns the object without Central Economy persistence. If a
player takes it, persistence is enabled when the item supports it.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `boolean` |
| Required | no |

### ObjectSpawnerEntry.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`Objects`](#objectspawnerfileobjects).`[]`.`name`

Name is either a game config class name or a P3D model path. P3D spawning is
limited to DZ/plants, DZ/plants_bliss, DZ/plants_sakhal, DZ/rocks,
DZ/rocks_bliss, and DZ/rocks_sakhal.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

### ObjectSpawnerEntry.pos

Key: `pos`

Path: [`Objects`](#objectspawnerfileobjects).`[]`.`pos`

Pos is the object's world position as an X/Y/Z vector in meters; Y is the
vertical coordinate.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `number` |
| Constraints | `minItems=3`; `maxItems=3` |

### ObjectSpawnerEntry.scale

Key: `scale`

Path: [`Objects`](#objectspawnerfileobjects).`[]`.`scale`

Scale is the size multiplier applied to the spawned object or model.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |

### ObjectSpawnerEntry.ypr

Key: `ypr`

Path: [`Objects`](#objectspawnerfileobjects).`[]`.`ypr`

YPR is the object's rotation in yaw, pitch, and roll order, in degrees. An empty
vector leaves rotation unspecified.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `number` |
| Constraints | `minItems=3`; `maxItems=3` |
